prompt:

Asset type: desktop AI redesign concept bitmap for TALKPIK AI user app

Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS title bar, device frame, or watermark. Auth-only screen with no sidebar. Center a compact card with lock/key icon, title '새 비밀번호 설정', short explanation, future expiry note, two password inputs with visibility icons, Obsidian full-width '비밀번호 변경' button, and login return link.
Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design-friendly auth form, compact, clean, secure, no marketing hero.
Color palette: Mist/Snow/Fog/Obsidian; Obsidian #09090b only for CTA; neutral helper text; no gradients.
Typography: Cosmica-like modern sans, Korean UI text as visual direction only, no negative letter spacing, stable input/button text.
Must preserve state signals: valid password reset link, new password and confirm password fields, eye icons, password guidance, future expiry note, change password CTA, login return link, no sidebar.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, expired-link message, decorative illustration, colorful CTA, heavy shadow, oversized radius.
